comment: Jeddah is Ghair! The sea breeze and the historical vibes of the old town make it the most beautiful coastal city.
The waterfront is perfect for late-night walks. The atmosphere here is always lively and full of joy.
Historical Jeddah is fascinating! The architecture is so unique. I spent hours taking photos of the balconies.
I loved the relaxed atmosphere and the amazing Red Sea diving. The food culture here is incredible.
